title: The Healing Waters of Hot Springs
description: The history of Hot Springs, Arkansas, and the tension between folk belief in the healing waters and the medicine of the day.

title: Saint Cyprian on Works and Alms
description: Saint Cyprian of Carthage's treatise on almsgiving and good works, set beside the Anglican doctrine of justification by faith alone.

title: The Journey of John Henry Newman
description: How studying the Church Fathers led John Henry Newman from Anglican priest to Catholic cardinal.

title: The Hidden Centuries: The Ozarks Before Europeans
description: The Ozarks from the time of Jesus to the arrival of Europeans, from the bluff shelters to the Osage and de Soto.

title: The Unicorn of Moonlight Hollow
description: A short bedtime poem about a unicorn, made for Marie.

title: The Walking House, Episode 1: The Lantern Girl (Full Cast)
description: Dramatized with a full cast, music and sound effects. A lantern maker joins a wizard and his walking house. Made for Marie.

title: The People of the Buffalo
description: The Osage, Cherokee, Shawnee and Delaware along the Buffalo River from the 1700s to the early 1900s, and how they came to leave.

title: The Carpenter Who Found the Longitude
description: How John Harrison, a self taught country carpenter, built clocks of wood and brass that let sailors find their way at sea.

title: The Acorn and the Oak: Newman's Middle Way on the Trinity
description: A lecture on how Newman's development of doctrine stands between a Trinitarian who says the creed was always plain and a Unitarian who says it was invented.

title: The Sword and the Scaffold
description: How the Church has wrestled with war and the death penalty, from the early martyrs and monks through Augustine, Trent and Pius XII to Pope Francis and Pope Leo XIV.

title: The Restless Church
description: Sixty years of American Christianity, from the Jesus People and the megachurch to Rob Bell, the Young Restless Reformed, and the turn toward the ancient churches, and where it may be going.

title: The Early Fathers on the Church
description: What Ignatius of Antioch, Irenaeus, and Cyprian said about bishops, the Eucharist, and unity, where Catholic and Protestant readings clash, and where the evidence is strong or thin.

title: Prophets and Bishops
description: Raymond Brown and other scholars on how the earliest church understood itself, from elders and the single bishop to the Spirit versus structure debate, and how the church answered the Montanist New Prophecy.

title: The Razor and the Reformation
description: William of Ockham, Gabriel Biel, nominalism, and how they shaped Martin Luther, with Louis Bouyer's argument from the Gospel Simplicity episode.
